fee_notes: Royalty is $600/month flat for first 3 months of operation, then 6% of Gross Revenues from services within Territory or $1,250/month minimum, whichever is greater. An additional 8% royalty applies to Gross Revenues from services rendered outside the Territory (does not count toward minimum). Franchise Option Program participants pay 10% of Gross Revenues for the initial 10-year term. Brand Fund Fee is $500/month per territory. Local advertising/marketing spend minimum is $3,500/month for first 2 years or until $240,000 in Gross Revenues is achieved over 12 consecutive months (not a fee paid to franchisor; paid to third parties). Website fee is $49/month (base) or $59/month (enhanced), collected by franchisor on behalf of third-party vendor. Business Center Fee is $1,500/month. Digital Marketing Services are $595/month per territory plus optional $49/month add-on. Digital Lead Generation is 20% of total ad spend or $100/month, whichever is greater. All fees subject to annual increase cap of 10% (with exceptions for optional and third-party fees).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | $600 for the first three months of operation. Then, 6% of each month's Gross Revenues or $1,250 per month, whichever is greater. 8% for Gross Revenues from services rendered outside the Territory. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | See Note 2 and 3.
Brand Fund Fee | $500 per month | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | You must pay a Brand Fund Fee for each territory.
Local Advertising, Marketing and Promotional Expenditures | $3,500 per month | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | See Note 4.
Late Payment Fee | $100 per violation, plus 12% interest/year, or the maximum rate allowed by law, from date the payment was originally due until paid. | As incurred | See Note 5.
Transfer Fee | $5,000 | Upon application to transfer | See Note 6.
Audit Amount | Cost of audit and interest on underpayment at 12% or the maximum legal rate allowed by law, whichever is greater. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | Payable only if audit shows an understatement of at least 5% of Gross Revenues for any month. See Note 7.
Testing or Supplier Approval Fee | $200 to $1,000 depending on the product, service or supplier you propose. | As incurred | Only payable if you would like us to review an unapproved product, service or supplier for approval and use. See Note 16.
Initial Training | $500 per person, per day. | At least 1 week before the Initial Training Program | Only payable if you send more than 2 attendees to the Initial Training Program. See Note 8 and Note 16.
Stone Training | $2,245 per attendee. | At least 1 week before the training begins | Payable to us. See Note 9 and Note 16.
Additional Training | Currently $500 per attendee. | As incurred | Payable to us. See Note 8 and Note 16.
Legal Fees and Expenses | All costs and expenses including attorneys' fees | As incurred | Only payable if you fail to pay amounts when due or fail to comply with the Franchise Agreement.
Renewal Fee | $2,500 | Upon renewal | Only payable if we agree to renew your franchise.
Indemnification | Will vary under circumstances | Upon demand | The amount of any claim, liability or loss we incur from your Franchised Business.
Website Fee | Currently, $49-$59 per month, depending on service you choose. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month or another date set by the vendor. | We collect this fee on behalf of a third-party vendor. See Note 10.
Business Center Fee | $1,500 per month | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | Payable to us. See Note 11 and Note 16.
Additional Email Licenses | $15 per month per license. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | See Note 12 and Note 16.
Deficiency Cure Expense Fee | Our costs and expenses | As incurred | Only payable if any deficiency in your operation of the Franchised Business continues after notice and we correct it. See Note 13.
De-identification Costs | Reasonable costs and expenses, which generally range from $1,000 to $2,500 | As incurred | Only payable if you fail to take steps to de-identify the Franchised Business after termination or expiration of your Franchise Agreement, and we do. See Note 14.
Convention Fee | Up to $1,500, depending upon costs | Due at registration | See Note 15.
Phone and Messaging Services | $34.99 per month per user, plus $0.012 cents per text message. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | Only payable if you choose to use this service. See Note 16 and Note 17.
Email Marketing Services | $169/mo. for up to 5,000 emails | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | Only payable if you choose to use this service. See Note 16 and Note 18.
Postcard Marketing Services | $199/mo. for up to 120 postcards. $1.65 per additional postcard. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | Only payable if you choose to use this service. See Note 16 and Note 19.
Digital Marketing Services | $595 per month, per territory, plus $49 per month for additional optional tools | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | See Note 16 and Note 20.
Digital Lead Generation Services | 20% of total advertising spend or $100, whichever is greater. | Due monthly on the 15th day of the month. | See Note 16 and Note 20.
